answer.answer: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MOPNG) introduced and launched the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 scheme [E02]. The ministry is responsible for administering this scheme, which provides free LPG connections to women from poor households [E01][E02]. The ministry also provides cash assistance for PMUY connections, including security deposits, pressure regulators, LPG hoses, and domestic gas consumer cards [E02].

The scheme provides free LPG connections to women from poor households
